name: Certified AI Practitioner
description: Fluent, safe, multi-vendor use of AI in daily work.

image.caption: Wirewalk Institute of AI badge: Certified AI Practitioner

criteria.narrative:
To earn this certificate a learner must hold a current course certificate for each of these courses: AI Foundations for Everyone (FND-101); Prompt and Context Engineering (PRM-201); Choosing AI Models and Vendors (VEN-210); Using AI Safely: Data Handling for Every Employee (SEC-101). Every course certificate must be current (not revoked or expired) when the program certificate is issued; the program certificate is renewed when every course certificate is current again.

Each course exam is taken online and is not proctored. The holder's identity is not verified; the name is the one on their account. This is a program certificate of completion and assessment issued by Wirewalk Institute of AI. It is not an accreditation, academic credit, license, or a certification from any vendor. Details: https://institute.wirewalk.com/certification/#limits
